name: Help Scout
description: Support and helpdesk: shared-inbox customer support platform (conversations, customers, mailboxes/inboxes, Docs knowledge base).
access_notes: Developers create an OAuth2 app self-serve under Your Profile > My Apps in any Help Scout account; Help Scout is a paid product with a free trial. No partner approval documented for API access.
mcp_notes: No official vendor MCP found on developer.helpscout.com. Composio HELP_SCOUT toolkit exists (129 tools, OAuth). Reputable community MCP: drewburchfield/help-scout-mcp-server on npm/GitHub.
uncertainty_notes: none_found in mcp_status refers specifically to a vendor-official MCP server; searched Help Scout developer docs and blog for MCP announcements and found none. Docs API (knowledge base) uses an API key via HTTP Basic auth, distinct from the OAuth2-only Inbox API 2.0.

evidence.note: Inbox API 2.0 uses OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows; app created self-serve under Your Profile > My Apps.
REST API at api.helpscout.net/v2, HAL+JSON, POST /v2/webhooks for event subscriptions with HMAC-SHA1 signatures; Docs API uses API key as Basic auth username.
Inbox API 2.0: HTTPS-only JSON API covering conversations, customers, mailboxes, users, reports.
Composio Help Scout toolkit with 129 tools; requires user-configured OAuth credentials.
Community (not vendor-official) MCP server covering Mailbox and Docs API read operations plus opt-in writes.
